overview.text: He sponsored laws creating student loan servicing rights and a diversionary program for FOID card applicants. He led a measure to increase compensation for the wrongfully incarcerated and a bill to ensure free mail for people in prison. He sponsored a law creating a Medicaid expansion task force. He announced $26 million in state grants to address food deserts. He led efforts to pass the SAFE-T Act, a 2021 criminal justice and police accountability law.
